overview: The Medford City Council addressed multiple municipal matters, including Law Department budget reductions, capital stabilization appropriations, and property transfer proposals. The council also approved resolutions supporting Tufts resident assistants, proposing a ban on black plastic takeout containers, and submitting comment on regional sewer overflow plans.

items.title: Resolution Honoring Congregational Church of West Medford
items.summary: Approved a resolution celebrating the 154-year history and closure of the Congregational Church of West Medford Sanctuary UCC.

items.title: Approval of Records and Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved previous meeting records and committee reports addressing resident services and an executive session legal settlement.

items.title: Cost Analysis Request for City Employee Vacation Time
items.summary: Referred a request for a cost analysis on increasing city employee vacation time to the Administration and Finance Committee and requested an HR report by the end of December.

items.title: Support Resolution for Tufts Resident Assistants
items.summary: Approved a resolution expressing full support for the United Labor of Tufts Resident Assistants in their contract negotiations with Tufts University.

items.title: Ordinance Request Banning Black Plastic Takeout Containers
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting the Energy and Environment Committee draft an ordinance banning black plastic takeout containers in consultation with local business groups.

items.title: Veterans Department Vacancy Update Request
items.summary: Referred a resolution requesting an update and temporary staffing plan for a vacancy in the Veterans Department to the city administration and the next regular meeting.

items.title: Comcast Grant of Location at 75 Riverside Avenue
items.summary: Approved a grant of location petition from Comcast to install underground conduit and manhole structures at 75 Riverside Avenue subject to engineering conditions.

items.title: Common Victualler's License for Pavement Coffeehouse
items.summary: Approved a Common Victualler's license for LSM Limited doing business as Pavement Coffeehouse at 177 College Avenue.

items.title: Linkage Fee Ordinance Update
items.summary: Referred an updated linkage fee ordinance incorporating an affordable housing category to the Community Development Board.

items.title: Approval of Legal Claims Settlements
items.summary: Approved two sidewalk slip-and-fall legal claim settlements of $5,000 each.

items.title: Capital Stabilization Fund Appropriations
items.summary: Approved Capital Stabilization Fund appropriations of $45,470 for firefighter turnout gear and $200,000 for ongoing soil remediation at 448 High Street.

items.title: School Project Capital Reappropriation
items.summary: Approved reappropriating $57,870 in Capital Stabilization funds from the Roberts Elementary repair project to cover a feasibility study deficit for Brooks Elementary.

items.title: City Charter Implementation Update
items.summary: Referred a resolution requesting city charter implementation steps to the Department of Elections and the Mayor following receipt of a legal memorandum.

items.title: McCormick Avenue Land Transfer and Sale
items.summary: Referred an order authorizing the transfer and sale of two municipal parcels on McCormick Avenue to the Committee of the Whole for broader review with city departments.

items.title: MWRA Combined Sewer Overflow Comment Letter
items.summary: Approved submitting a comment letter to the MWRA project team advocating for complete elimination of combined sewer overflows in regional waterways.

items.title: Police Chief Search Funding Request
items.summary: Tabled a stabilization fund appropriation request for the police chief search.

items.title: FY2027 Law Department Supplemental Budget
items.summary: Approved cutting $297,553.44 from the proposed Law Department supplemental budget, providing one month of salary, and requested details on a planned legal practices audit.

items.title: Board and Commission Appointments
items.summary: Approved appointments and reappointments to the Cemetery Trustees, Chevalier Auditorium Commission, and Board of Health.
